title: Patch: full-art cards in your hand show only their art, no name
notes: A full-art card (R1017001, R2655000) in the viewer's own hand now draws only its art, its cost gem and a Unit's attack and health: no name banner, Mythic signature, rarity gem, set mark or crest (R2723000). Its name stays in its words for a screen reader and the tooltip; every other view prints the whole face. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Full-art cards in your hand
changes: A full-art card in your hand now shows just its art, its cost and, on a Unit, its attack and health. Hover over it, or hold it on a touch screen, to see its name and the whole card.
